column3: Right. I've rebuilt yer weapon's core usin' the ecliptic arcanite ye procured.
Now it's time to get slicin'!
Another resoundin' success. Yer weapon's free from its illusory shroud, an' all them enhancements are completely untouched.
Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creation: !
Behold the true, unfettered power o' me latest creations:  an' !
As yer well aware, the best is yet to come. Only once yer phantom weapon's filled to the brim with martial memories can we call the bleedin' job done!
There's enough ecliptic arcanite left over, so I can soon get crackin'. Dodokkuli'll handle the grunt work first, mind.
As good as yer phantom weapon feels right now, know that there's plenty more power to wring out o' the thing. Can't leave that potential untapped, can we?
